name: MapViewer3D
description: Live 3D map of Hagga Basin and Deep Desert with players, bases, vehicles, hazards and resources. Nothing to install on the server: terrain and models stream from GitHub, live data comes from the console API with a key you create (Settings > API Keys: maps Read, bases Read). Live worms, NPCs, vehicles and storms appear when the console offers Realtime Data. Optional share links (they need the MapViewer3D share gateway on the server) let players without a console account view the map.
author: dev-prophet-code
